title: Leah Solivan recaps her Unprecedented Lunch with Eric Ries
summary: Leah Solivan — TaskRabbit founder and host of Breaking Precedent — publicly recaps the Unprecedented Lunch she hosted with Eric on Incorruptible: founders, investors, LPs, and operators around one table, sponsored by HSBC Innovation Banking. The room that produced Pam Kostka's 'Endurance is a design choice' write-up.
blockquote: I recently had the privilege of hosting an Unprecedented Lunch with Eric Ries to discuss the ideas behind his new book, Incorruptible. We explored what it takes to build organizations that stay true to their mission as they scale, and why trust, governance, and long-term thinking may be some of the greatest competitive advantages of all.
attribution_title: Founder, TaskRabbit; host, Breaking Precedent podcast; Precedent.vc
